t: This DEWALT TCT saw blade is engineered for precise wood cutting across various applications. Designed for use with chop, mitre, and table saws, it is ideal for professional carpenters and joiners requiring reliable performance on site or in workshops. The 216mm diameter and 30mm bore ensure compatibility with common saw models. Featuring 60 tungsten carbide teeth, it delivers fine, clean cuts in different wood types. Construction-grade carbide offers excellent resistance to chipping and cracking, promoting a long blade life. 5° positive rake angle facilitates efficient material removal and smooth operation, ensuring consistent results for wood cutting tasks.
b: For use with Chop, Mitre & Table Saws
Positive 5° Rake Angle for Efficient Cutting
